reasons.persona_fit: Directly targets the intended small-business audience and respects all voice and CTA rules, with only a minor perspective shift from 'you' to 'the owner' mid-text.
reasons.clarity: The core message is immediately clear, well structured, and explains proof-of-concept debt in plain, accessible terms without jargon.
reasons.actionability: Provides a highly concrete, feasible method: a three-column one-page handover note to evaluate deferred items before committing to production rollout.
reasons.factual_grounding: Strictly adheres to evidence boundaries without inventing metrics, customer results, or unbuilt capabilities.
